meta.name: CCNL Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione (Confetra) - Personale viaggiante

notes.text: STAFF: travelling staff (personale viaggiante) of the CCNL Logistica: drivers of qualifiche 3 (C, B, A), 2 (F, E, D) and 1 (H, G) and riders of letters I (bicycle) and L (moped or motorcycle), art. 2 pp. 25-26, tables pp. 81-82. The non-travelling staff is logistica-trasporto-confetra. Every level is an operaio.

RIDER PARAMETERS: letter I starts at parametro 110 and moves to 116 after 6 months; letter L starts at 110, moves to 116 after 6 months and to 119 after further 9 months (art. 2, p. 26). Each parametro is a level (I110, I116, L110, L116, L119): the request names the parametro reached, the engine does not move the worker.
TRANCHES: four tranches: 1.1.2025, 1.1.2026, 1.1.2027 (EPA), 1.6.2027 (minimo and EPA), +260.00 at B3 in all (140 minimo, 120 EPA, p. 82). base_salary is minimo plus EPA.
SENIORITY INCREMENTS: biennial, at most 5 bienni, amounts of the travelling column of art. 17 c. 2 (p. 41).
APPRENTICESHIP: Tabella A (p. 75): drivers G1 and H1 75%, 85%, then 100%; riders I and L 100% throughout. Tabella B: drivers A3, B3, C3 (5 years) and D2, E2, F2 (4 years) 90%, 95%, then 100%.

WORKING TIME: drivers work 39 hours a week (art. 11 c. 1) over up to 6 days, averaged over 4 weeks; the discontinuous drivers of art. 11 bis (qualifiche 3 A-C and 2 D-F, after the verification procedure) work 47 hours ordinary. The regime moves only the threshold beyond which an hour is overtime: the monthly pay is the same and the hourly pay divides it by 168 under every regime (art. 13 c. 8), so the request declares the overtime hours beyond the worker's own regime.

TRAVELLING WEEKEND OVERTIME: Saturday and Sunday overtime of the travelling staff is 30% (art. 13 c. 6, p. 39): Saturday as weekday overtime, Sunday as rest_day overtime (OT_RIPOSO). Overtime on the festività of artt. 60 and 71 is holiday overtime at 65%, 75% at night. The rates do not add up and the higher absorbs the lower (c. 7): a weekend overtime hour at night is night overtime (50%), reported as night.

NOT MODELLED: the night allowance of art. 16 for a trasferta under 18 hours overlapping the night hours (paid only from 18 hours), the 50% on the Sunday and holiday work within the ordinary hours (art. 12 c. 4), and the 4.5 days of paid leave of art. 11 c. 11. The trasferta of art. 62 and the night allowance of a trasferta of 18-24 hours are paid by TravelAllowanceEvent.

limitation.remediation: Pay the night allowance of art. 16 and the Sunday or holiday work within the ordinary hours outside the engine.

notes.text: CONGLOBATED MINIMUMS: base_salary values are the conglobated monthly minimum pay (minimum pay table + contingenza per Art. 61 note + EPA). Primary check: Art. 61 of the consolidated text September 2025 — 'From 1.1.2001 the indennità di contingenza has been conglobated into the minimum pay tables together with the EDR of EUR 10.33 per month'. fixed_allowances is empty for all levels.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 168 hours/month. Primary source: Art. 61 para. 3 consolidated text September 2025 — 'The hourly pay is obtained by dividing the monthly pay by 168'.

ICE: the Indennità di Copertura Economica (ICE) was a provisional element in force until 31.12.2024. It ceases from 1.1.2025 with the renewal taking effect. base_salary values do not include ICE (ceased element). The consolidated text cites net increases of EUR 230 at 3S compared to the previous pay including ICE — the difference from the algebraic sum of the tranches (EUR 290 from base without ICE) corresponds to the pre-existing ICE value for that level.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14 (tredicesima Art. 18 + quattordicesima Art. 19 consolidated text September 2025).

EPA: Elemento Professionale d'Area, a component introduced by the 6.12.2024 renewal. Included in base_salary values from 1.1.2025. Not shown separately because it forms an integral part of the minimum pay (it affects all contractual and statutory entitlements) — see Confetra circ283-2024.

EDR: the EDR of EUR 10.33/month (agreement 26 Jan 2001) is conglobated into the minimum pay tables (Art. 61 note). The EDR of art. 60 c. 8 (workers in service on 26 January 2011) and the EDR of the agreement of 18 May 2021 (13 mensilità, no effect on other institutes) are paid as allowances; the 2021 EDR may still enter the daily base of absences and sickness, which 'nessuna incidenza su alcun istituto contrattuale' excludes.
INPS: uses 2026-industria.json (TaxSector.INDUSTRIA). File already present — no changes to the tax file.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

location.section: Art. 63 A) c. 7, 8, 12 (Sezione prima)
location.quote: corresponsione dell'intera retribuzione globale mensile per 3 mesi e della metà di essa per altri 5 mesi, se aventi anzianità di servizio non superiore a 5 anni

provenance.transformation: Up to 5 years of seniority: job kept 245 days (c. 7), counted over the 24 months before the day (c. 8), 3 months in full and 5 at half (c. 12): 90 days at 100%, days 91-240 at 50%, then unpaid. Above 5 years: 365 days over 30 months, 5 months in full and 7 at half: 150 days at 100%, days 151-360 at 50%. Months of 30 days; the band from 60 months reads 'superiore ai 5 anni' as five completed years and any further day. The CCNL treatment tops up the INPS indemnity to these shares of the retribuzione globale (c. 13).
provenance.note: Malattie particolarmente gravi (INPS circ. 95/2016): left out of the comporto count (c. 8: 'ad esclusione di quelli per malattie particolarmente gravi') and paid 'con la corresponsione dell'intera retribuzione globale mensile per 18 mesi' (c. 12): 540 days of 30-day months from the first day of the episode, stated by SicknessEpisode.serious_illness.

location.section: Art. 62 cc. 3 and 7, dal 1.1.2025

provenance.transformation: Territorio nazionale 23.80, 35.02, 43.16 and estero 31.94, 45.05, 62.49 for 6-12, 12-18, 18-24 hours away (c. 3); under 6 hours no allowance (c. 8). C. 7: 'Le differenze in più rispetto ai valori esenti dall'IRPEF hanno natura retributiva e sono computabili esclusivamente nel T.F.R.': the part above the exemption enters the TFR base (above_exempt). Art. 16 c. 1 (p. 40): 'una indennità di euro 0,93 per ciascuna indennità di trasferta da 18 a 24 ore [...] L'indennità di lavoro notturno ha natura retributiva e viene computata esclusivamente ai fini del T.F.R.': 0.93 for each day of 18 hours or more, taxable and in the TFR base. Not modelled: the same allowance for a shorter trasferta overlapping the night hours.
provenance.note: Not modelled: the hours abroad and in Italy of one day cumulated (c. 5), and the sum of several short services (c. 9): the caller states the hours of the span.

reviews.scope: Inherited from logistica-trasporto-confetra, of which this file is a copy: the review covered that file's levels; here it stands for the shared rules (work rules, parameters) only. Every payable rule of the file (55 records) read again in the signed testo unico of the renewal of 6 December 2024 (Verbale di accordo 25 September 2025), published by Confetra; the URLs the file cited return 404.
findings: Corrected: every one of the 36 salary periods. The base salary is the minimo plus the EPA of the tables of pp. 80-81 for non-travelling staff; the file held values about 88-110 EUR too high. The printed Totale of the 1 January 2027 table already includes the minimo increase of 1 June 2027; the Legacoop circular of 19 December 2024 (p. 2) confirms that January 2027 is an EPA-only step, so the period holds minimo plus EPA.
Corrected: the Quadri receive the indennità di funzione of 51.65 EUR a month (Art. 6 c. 4, p. 17), which the file lacked.
Corrected: the daily quota is 1/22 (Art. 61 c. 3, Sezione prima, p. 86), not 1/26, which applies to a six-day week of non-travelling staff and to Sezione seconda (Art. 73 c. 5).

Verified: 14 monthly payments (Artt. 18-19), the accrual of fractions over 15 days (Art. 18 c. 2, Art. 19 c. 2), seniority (Art. 17) and 22 days of leave (Art. 24). Pages are PDF page numbers, equal to the printed ones.

Assumed: sickness. Art. 63 A) c. 7-12 keeps the job 245 or 365 days and pays 3 months in full and 5 at half (up to 5 years of service) or 5 and 7, counted over 24 or 30 months; the cumulation model holds one window in whole years for every band, so the rule is not expressible and the file's 100% for 180 days is wrong.
Left derived: the overtime rates (30%, 50%, 65%, 75%, Art. 13 c. 6) match, but their start of 2023-05-01 is not stated; the level descriptions are paraphrases.
Not modelled: the EDR of Art. 60 c. 8 (10 EUR at level 3S, re-parametrised) for workers in service on 26 January 2011, which affects every entitlement, and level 6J and travelling staff.

reviews.scope: Inherited from logistica-trasporto-confetra, of which this file is a copy: the review covered that file's levels; here it stands for the shared rules (work rules, parameters) only. Sickness rule of art. 63 A), now expressible with a window and steps per seniority band; readiness of the file.
findings: The sickness rule was assumed (100% for 180 days, not the CCNL's): it is now 90 days in full and 150 at half within 24 months, comporto 245 days, up to 5 years of seniority; 150 in full and 210 at half within 30 months, comporto 365 days, above.
With no assumed or missing payable rule left and the salary tables, additional months, divisor and seniority verified on 2026-10-11, the file is promoted to reviewed.

reviews.scope: Travelling staff: levels, salary tables of the four tranches, seniority, EDR 2011 and 2021, apprenticeship, overtime, against the signed testo unico (Verbale 25 September 2025).
findings: This file was created from logistica-trasporto-confetra for the travelling staff, which that file left out: same rules and review history, with the travelling levels, seniority amounts, EDR and apprenticeship tracks.

51 of the 52 salary values equal minimo plus EPA and the printed Totale of pp. 81-82; F2 prints a Totale 0.06 above the sum at every tranche. The Legacoop circular of December 2024 confirms the F2 minimo (1.791,51 + 87,63), so the Totale is the misprint: F2 takes the sum and stays derived.
Saturday and Sunday overtime of the travelling staff is 30% (art. 13 c. 6); the engine has one holiday band, left as a limitation.
Tabella B (p. 75) reads by year: drivers A3-C3 over 5 years and D2-F2 over 4, 90% the first year, 95% the second, 100% after.

reviews.scope: Weekend overtime and working time of the travelling staff (artt. 11, 11 bis, 13).
findings: Sunday overtime of the travelling staff is 30% (art. 13 c. 6), not the 65% of the holiday band: new band OT_RIPOSO on the rest_day overtime kind.
The 47-hour regime of art. 11 bis changes the overtime threshold, not the pay: the hourly divisor is 168 under every regime (art. 13 c. 8); the limitation travelling_working_time is closed.
The serious illnesses of INPS circ. 95/2016 were a limitation (grave_illness): now paid in full for 18 months and left out of the comporto when SicknessEpisode.serious_illness says so.

reviews.scope: Indennità di trasferta of the travelling staff (art. 62).
findings: The allowance amounts of art. 62 c. 3 from 1.1.2025 and the TFR rule of c. 7 are now CCNL data: a TravelAllowanceEvent without daily_amount takes the amount of its hours away.
